decisions.reason: It builds squarely on the firm's core market-data and analytics capabilities, and as a surviving product after the 2024 portfolio pruning it likely offers enough learning and customer value to justify further development.
The area definition tool complements the firm's platform and process-support business closely, so the firm can readily absorb user feedback and improve it with existing knowledge and in-house R&D.

Although its lower web prominence and overlap with previously withdrawn comparison products raise the risk of exit, it remains close enough to the firm's established tariff and market-process expertise that management would still keep it for now.
